the edge dislocations, which are present in YBCO thin films, are not only responsible for anisotropic vortex-pinning but also for the microwave surface resistance.
edge dislocations are the key to high J/sub c/ in epitaxial films, whereas the effect of dislocations on R/sub s/ is less significant.
